conviction_note: Near-non-result. The FY2026 numbers look set to land on the unrevised plan and roughly on the one-analyst IFIS consensus. What decides this print is the first FY2027 guide, measured against the company's own mid-term floor (OP of at least 3.2bn yen), and the guide is unknowable from outside. So p_up 54 is a slight lean. abs_move 6.0 is well above the 2.83 proxy because the real-date reactions at the last eight prints were -6.3, -11.7, +11.0, -0.4, +12.7, +5.3, -9.4 and -1.6, with a median near 7.8. impact_sum (+1.1) and impact_scaled (+0.48) agree in sign; the scaled number is smaller because most of its weight is the unsigned size of a guide-driven print.
bar: FY2026 (Aug) company plan, unrevised since 2025-10-10: sales 27,800 / OP 2,900 / ordinary 3,050 / net 2,200 (mn yen), dividend 54 yen (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710591327.pdf). IFIS consensus is a single analyst (a US major broker, Neutral, target 2,100 yen): sales 28,250 / OP 2,960 / ordinary 3,175 / net 2,300 (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=6289, as of 2026-10-08). FY2027 bar: the mid-term plan revised 2025-10-10 has sales 30,000-33,000, OP of at least 3,200, overseas sales of at least 7,500 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251010/140120251010571718.pdf). The analyst's 12-month forward EPS of 94.5 yen (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportTarget?bcode=6289) puts the street at about that level. A single estimate source means the consensus bar is only partly sourced, so the sizes are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed shorts 0.52% (one seller), up 0.01pt, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline; https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin ratio (信用倍率) 0.70 (kabutan header 2026-10-09, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6289&b=n202510140381), so margin shorts exceed margin longs: a mild squeeze setup on a positive guide. The kabutan margin-history page returned a CAPTCHA. There is no option skew. priced_lean_pct is +0.095. Run-up is +5.47% over 20 days and -4.09% over 5 days, inside a 1,830-2,030 yen range for three months.

findings.finding: The FY2026 plan needs Q4 (Jun-Aug) OP of 1,120 mn yen against 1,167 a year earlier. The Q3 presentation says the high-margin domestic development-type press-in projects were scheduled into Q4. Work-in-progress rose from 777 to 1,321 mn yen between Aug-25 and May-26. The Q4 ordinary plan (1,007) assumes a non-operating loss after +263 of non-operating gains in 9M. Giken Asia expects record sales for FY Jun-26. So the year most likely lands at or slightly above plan and close to the IFIS 2,960 / 3,175. The offset: Q3 parts sales were pulled forward ahead of the June consumables price hike, and overseas machinery needs a large Q4 (1,734 against 728 in Q3).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-04-10: H1 beat its own H1 plan, but kabutan/Fisco said it missed the market's expectation, and the stock fell 9.42% close-to-close (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6289&b=n202604140126). 2026-07-10: Q3 with 67.0% progress against a five-year average of 71.4% moved -1.59%. 2026-01-09: a strong Q1 moved +5.34%.
findings.why_not_priced: The plan was held and no revision has been filed. The Q4 composition (development projects concentrated in Q4, the non-operating cushion) is in the presentation, not on the kabutan header that prints 67% progress against a 71.4% five-year average and reads as a shortfall. If the market had read Q4 as covered, the stock would not have sat flat at 1,830-2,030 since the Q3 print. That said, this lands inside the company's own guide, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Same document family as the 決算短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710591327.pdf), so it is not independent. Giken Asia record-sales release (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710590895.pdf) is a separate company statement pointing the same way for overseas.

findings.finding: The new FY2027 (Aug-27) guide is the final year of a mid-term plan the company already cut, on 2025-10-10, to a figure it called 'more realistic' (OP of at least 3,200, sales 30-33bn, overseas at least 7.5bn). Its initial guides have shown growth (FY24 +10.6%, FY25 +5%, FY26 +13%). Supporting inputs: the new SX machine series has been on sale since spring 2026, a consumables price hike took effect in June 2026, and in-house consumables production started in September 2026 to cut cost. Against them: the Q3 tanshin says domestic customer capex stays cautious on construction costs and labour shortages.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-10 FY print: a +13% OP guide plus a 2bn yen buyback moved +12.66% close-to-close despite the mid-term-plan cut (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6289&b=n202510140381). 2024-10-11 FY print: -6.27%.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody outside the company knows the guide. The one analyst's 12-month forward EPS of 94.5 sits at roughly the mid-term floor, so a guide at or above 3,200 is roughly the bar, not a beat. The lean is slight and rests on the company's own floor and its guiding habit. If the market expected a guide well above the floor, the stock would trade above the analyst's 2,100 target rather than 7% below it.
findings.independence: The consumables in-house production release (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260929/140120260929541686.pdf) and the India six-machine order (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260615/140120260615570537.pdf) are separate company documents supporting the FY2027 cost and overseas lines. No third-party series was found.

findings.finding: The dividend policy adopted 2025-10-10 sets DOE 3.5% as a floor from FY2026. With BPS about 1,543 yen and rising, the FY2027 dividend is mechanically at least about 54-56 yen against a 40%-payout figure near 38, so a small 増配 or a held 54 is close to locked in. The first full year of the new Premium 優待 (Feb and Aug record dates) is already running. Last year's FY print also brought a 2bn yen (5.22%) buyback. Cash fell from 8,585 to 7,139 mn yen after it, and nothing found signals a repeat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-10: a buyback plus the DOE introduction contributed to +12.66%. 2025-12-23: the 優待 launch was followed by a fall ('買い続かず', https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6289&b=n202512240551).
findings.why_not_priced: The DOE floor is public, so the dividend level is largely priced. What is not priced is whether a second buyback comes. Holders who expect a repeat of last year's could be disappointed, which caps this small and two-sided.
findings.independence: The buyback document (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251010/140120251010571736.pdf) gives last year's precedent. Q3 balance sheet cash (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260710591327.pdf).

outside_window.finding: METI Global South subsidy for the India press-in DX/national-standard feasibility study runs 2026-11-01 to 2027-10-30. It is a long-dated overseas option and does not resolve at this print.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none filed, and FY2026 likely lands near plan or consensus. Returns: DOE 3.5% floor makes the dividend nearly mechanical; a repeat buyback is possible but unsignalled. New-year guide: FY2027 against the mid-term floor OP ≥3,200 and the single-analyst street at about that level; this is the deciding item and unknowable. Quarter: 9M OP progress 61% (ordinary 67%) against 85% (FY24) and 55% (FY25) at the same stage; Q4 plan 1,120 OP against 1,167 a year earlier, with development projects explicitly scheduled into Q4.

baseline_tension: Agrees mildly with the slightly positive lean (+0.095) and the margin-short setup, and cuts against nothing; the 20-day run-up of +5.5% is mostly the late-September move already given back (-4.1% over five days). The strongest positive the release could carry is a FY2027 guide above the mid-term 3.2bn floor plus a new buyback, as on 2025-10-10. I looked for signs of a buyback and found none, so it is not counted. The strongest negative is a guide below the mid-term floor on domestic weakness, the April 2026 pattern of 'beat own plan, miss the market'.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (a negative on a series the market already has) and rule 2 (too many negatives) address negative calls, and this draft has none. The strongest positive the release could carry is already written into baseline_tension.
